QuestInfo.name: To Lith Harbor!
QuestInfo.0: To deliver a message of #p12000# to #p1002101#, you need to go to Victoria Island. The only way you can get there is to pay #p22000# in #m60000#... Fortunately, #p12000# said he will ask #p22000# a favor. Go to #b#p22000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p22000# let you board for free as #p12000# request. Good, now on to Victoria Island! #m104000000#! Once there, you have to find #b#p1002101##k.
QuestInfo.2: You met #p1002101# in #m104000000#. Hmmm. This tough and stubborn guy is a friend of #p12000#! Amazing! Fortunately, #p1002101# will do a favor for #p12000#.

1.0: Welcome to #m104000000#. Is this your first time in Victoria Island? Huh? You came here to deliver the message from #p12000#?

yes.0: Ah. So, #p12100# can't protect Maple Island by herself, huh? Ok. Then I'll hire one more person. I can do that for my friend's sake. Thank you.
